steps.label: Warten auf Render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for i in $(seq 1 60); do [ -f sr_done2.txt ] && break; sleep 15; done; [ -f sr_done2.txt ] && cat sr_done2.txt

steps.label: Hochladen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_film2.mp4 -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < vurl_s.txt)") && b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_thumb_a.jpg -H "Content-Type: image/jpeg" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < turl_s.txt)") && rm -f vurl_s.txt turl_s.txt && echo "video $a thumb $b" > sr_up.txt && cat sr_up.txt && [ "$a" = 200 ] && [ "$b" = 200 ]
